turns.user: Can we buy the 5-litre gaskets from a supplier that doesn't have a food-grade certificate? Their price is much better.
turns.agent: No, we cannot. According to **Purchase Policy §6.2** (and **Supplier Policy §4.1**), parts that come into contact with food—such as gaskets—may be bought **only** from a supplier holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. Even if a supplier's price is better, a valid certificate is strictly required before any order can be placed.

clauses.heading: 6. Supplier qualification
clauses.text: 6.2 **Parts that come into contact with food** (gaskets, lids, body blanks and any other item marked food-contact in the item master) may be bought only from a supplier holding a **valid food-grade certificate** on file in Bahi. The certificate must be uploaded and checked **before the first order** is placed. An expired certificate counts as no certificate.

clauses.heading: 4. Food-grade certificates
clauses.text: 4.5 An expired certificate counts as no certificate. The supplier stays ACTIVE in the master, but no food-contact part may be ordered from it until a new certificate is uploaded and checked.

clauses.heading: 4. Food-grade certificates

clauses.heading: 4. Food-grade certificates
clauses.text: 4.7 Bahi does not stop an order to a supplier without a certificate. The check in this section is done by the person raising the order, and by the approver.

clauses.heading: 6. Supplier qualification
clauses.text: 6.2 **Parts that come into contact with food** (gaskets, lids, body blanks and any other item marked food-contact in the item master) may be bought only from a supplier holding a **valid food-grade certificate** on file in Bahi. The certificate must be uploaded and checked **before the first order** is placed. An expired certificate counts as no certificate.

clauses.heading: 4. Food-grade certificates
clauses.text: 4.5 An expired certificate counts as no certificate. The supplier stays ACTIVE in the master, but no food-contact part may be ordered from it until a new certificate is uploaded and checked.

clauses.heading: 4. Food-grade certificates
